program:
alphabet a b c

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
is_c = symbol c
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@j & !is_c@j, is_bos@j & !is_b@j & !is_c@j)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & is_a@j & !is_c@j, !is_b@j & !is_c@j)
h1_3 = rightmost(is_c@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j, !is_bos@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & !is_b@j & h1_1@j & h1_2@j, !is_a@j & !is_b@j & is_c@j & h1_1@j)
h2_2 = leftmost(!is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j & h1_2@j, !is_c@j)
accept = !h1_1 & h1_2 & h1_3 & !h2_1 & h2_2

output accept
